title: Recruiter ATS Pipeline Overhaul & In-Modal Candidate Resume Review System
spec:
MISSION: Full 360-degree overhaul of the Recruiter / Employer ATS Pipeline to eliminate the critical gap where employers cannot view or preview candidate resumes.

1. BACKEND AUTHORIZATION ENDPOINT:
   - Implement `GET /api/employer/jobs/:jobId/applications/:applicationId/resume` in `backend/index.js` (or `backend/routes/jobsData.js`).
   - Strict RBAC: Verify requesting user is the owner of the job (`job.employerId === req.user.uid`).
   - Fetch candidate's resume document (`repo.getResume(application.applicantId, application.resumeId)`) from authoritative MariaDB.
   - Return full resume payload ({ success: true, resume, application }).

2. FRONTEND PIPELINE ELEVATION (EmployerApplicantPipeline.jsx):
   - Retain `resumeId`, `resumeUrl`, and `coverLetter` in the mapped row state from `getJobApplications()`.
   - Add dedicated 'Resume' column to the applicant table with a sleek Cuba-styled 'View Resume' button (`FiFileText` icon).
   - Implement an in-modal resume preview dialog reusing `TemplateRenderer.jsx` so the recruiter can preview the candidate's formatted CV in-modal without downloading PDF files.
   - Include Zoom, Print, and Download affordances in the modal header.
   - Add interactive stage transition triggers (Pending -> Interview -> Offer -> Hired -> Rejected) calling `PATCH /api/job-applications/:applicationId/status`.

3. RIGOROUS REAL-DATA VERIFICATION (ANTI-EMPTY-STATE):
   - The test MUST NOT pass on 0 rows. Tests passing on empty states are strictly prohibited.
   - Automated test must submit a real application with a candidate resume to an active employer job.
   - Log in as the employer owning that requisition.
   - Assert candidate appears in the pipeline table with their name, role, applied date, and 'View Resume' button.
   - Click 'View Resume' and assert `[role="dialog"]` mounts `TemplateRenderer` displaying candidate's actual personal info, experience, and education.
   - Transition stage and verify MariaDB persists the update with 0 console errors, 0 page errors, and 0 failed API calls.
invariants: Tests MUST NOT pass on empty state (0 applicant rows). Must verify real applicant resume rendering.
DOCX high-fidelity export engine and MariaDB ATS scoring engine remain frozen
Zero synthetic mock servers or fake in-memory bypasses (must use live Vite:3000 + API:8080 + MariaDB)
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/employer/jobs/:jobId/applications/:applicationId/resume returns 200 with real candidate resume for authorized employer and 403 for unauthorized users
EmployerApplicantPipeline.jsx renders 'Resume' column with 'View Resume' button for every applicant
Clicking 'View Resume' opens in-modal TemplateRenderer displaying formatted resume, zoom controls, and contact header
Stage transition dropdown successfully updates application status in MariaDB
Playwright E2E test exercises the entire flow with real submitted application data and passes with 0 console errors

plan.summary: DIR-007 audit complete: backend endpoint verified live (200 + real resume payload). Found real bug: getApplications returns snake_case rows so pipeline maps applicantName/appliedAt to fallbacks. Plan: fix row mapping, add Resume column + in-modal TemplateRenderer w/ zoom/print/download, stage transitions, and real-data Playwright E2E.
steps: 1. Fix pipeline row mapping (snake_case + camelCase) retaining resumeId/resumeUrl/coverLetter
2. Add Resume column w/ FiFileText View Resume button
3. Add in-modal TemplateRenderer resume viewer with zoom/print/download + stage transitions
4. Real-data Playwright E2E against live Vite:3000 + API:8080 + MariaDB
5. Run regression gates + build, submit evidence

evidence.summary: DIR-007 COMPLETE: 4/4 Playwright E2E PASS (EXIT=0) against LIVE Vite:3000 + API:8080 + MariaDB. Real-data proof: spec provisions a genuine Firebase candidate identity, writes a real resume + real application through the live API, and FAILS LOUDLY if the seeded row is absent or resume-less (anti-empty-state). Stage1 pipeline shows RESUME column + View Resume for all 7 real applicants (0 console/page/API errors). Stage2 in-modal TemplateRenderer rendered the candidate actual CV (Anika Raghavan / Helios Analytics / NIT), zoom measured 794px->873px, print+download present, verified by screenshot + DOM box (page 794x1171, dialog 896x920, no overlap). Stage3 RBAC: owner=200 with real resume; non-owner=403 and NO payload leaked; anonymous=401. Stage4 stage transition persisted to MariaDB (status=interview, revision=1) and confirmed by API re-read. FIXED 3 real defects found during verification: (1) getApplications returns snake_case rows so applicantName/appliedAt silently rendered 'Applicant'/'-'; (2) CSS zoom was applied as 100 (100x scale, 79400px page) - now zoom/100 with a print-width assertion pinning 600-900px; (3) cover letter was raw dangerouslySetInnerHTML - now sanitized via sanitizeRichText. Also removed a duplicate updateJobApplicationStatus export I had introduced. Gates: build 3.05s 0 errors; eslint 0 errors; 65/65 product regression (cuba-employer-portal, employer-lifecycle, unlayered-css-guard, job-application-ai-pitch-and-preview); test:security:static 52/52. FROZEN surfaces zero git diff (51 templates, TemplateRenderer, atsScore, exportService, resumeData, sanitizeHtml, repositories, database). Seeded test rows removed from MariaDB afterwards (DB restored to pre-existing single application); all scratch scripts deleted.
